C1.worst_defect: The hero says who it is for ("Point of sale for Vendure") but nowhere says who should NOT use it or how it sits against Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed; the limits are listed further down but never framed as 'pick something else if…'. The lone "For cashiers: At the till" link under the two buttons reads as an afterthought.

C2.worst_defect: No sign of project health or support for a client deciding whether to adopt: the changelog shows three plugin releases, all 1–6 Oct 2026, with 0.3.0 "Released the same day as 0.2.0, a few hours later", and nothing for six weeks since; no named maintainer, organisation or support/issues channel on home. "MIT licensed" self-hosting also quietly needs "your own RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)" with no cost given, and demo analytics go to ph.wcpos.com, another brand's domain, explained only on Connect a till.
C2.where: changelog.desktop.01; home.desktop.02 (Before you start, footer); connect-a-till 'Where your data goes'

C3.worst_defect: The path works but carries known traps the reader must patch by hand: "On plugin 0.3.0 the vendurepos-pos-till role has no ReadOrder: add it yourself, or the till sells but its order history is refused"; the code names differ from the product ("TallyPosPlugin, the TallyPosSell permission and the /tally/v1 routes"); and a collapsed "If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app" legacy-domain aside adds noise.

C4.worst_defect: Docs are thorough and honest but dense: the Tally/VendurePOS naming split runs through every page (TallyPos1790648006022 migrations, tallyNeedsAdminCommands, tallyResolveNeedsAdmin), and the changelog's "Full release notes" sit collapsed so the first slice shows little of what changed.

C5.worst_defect: The "What it does today" grid mixes two boxed proof cards ("Read the acceptance test", "Read the 200-send test") with eight unboxed items, so the section looks unevenly finished; otherwise clean in light and dark.

C6.worst_defect: Minor: on the phone hero, "For cashiers: At the till" sits alone as a bare text link under the stacked buttons; tables reflow to cards and code wraps cleanly elsewhere.

C7.worst_defect: Minor: Lighthouse mobile LCP 2.3 s (/) and 2.4 s (/docs/quick-start) with about 53 KiB of unused JavaScript flagged; all pages 200 (404 as expected), JSON-LD, sitemap, llms.txt and search all present.

overall_worst.defect: A client cannot tell whether this project is alive or supported: three plugin releases all between 1 and 6 Oct 2026 (0.3.0 "Released the same day as 0.2.0, a few hours later"), nothing since, no named maintainer or support channel, and the 'MIT licensed' self-host path depends on a paid RxDB Premium token whose cost is not stated.
overall_worst.fix: Add a short 'Project status' block on home: who maintains it, latest release and latest commit dates, where to ask for help or file issues, and what the RxDB Premium licence costs; plus one 'Not for you if…' line (e.g. you need refunds at the till, a cash drawer, iPad tills or a non-Postgres store — use Shopify POS, Square or Lightspeed instead).
